h4: Order cancellation in case of unconventional pricing
p5: Low market depth in local markets may sometimes cause the price of transactions in a market to be shown higher or lower than the actual price of cryptocurrencies. This happens because some users, being unfamiliar with the market, place orders at the wrong price. Also, in many cases, due to not distinguishing the limit order from the limit order or registering the wrong price, users cause irrational price changes and the so-called extreme price range, which will cost them. Despite Artina's warnings at the time of unconventional pricing, sending orders at the wrong price happens repeatedly by users. Therefore, the option of canceling transactions in Artina is considered. In other words, based on the number of trades made in the desired price range, the volume of trades and the price difference created with the current market price, all or part of the trades may be canceled. Of course, it is possible that none of these transactions will be canceled. With this feature, there is a possibility of returning part of the losses caused by sending an unconventional order to the person who made a mistake, and because the price changes were not real and the transaction was made only because of a mistake in pricing, the people who traded with unrealistic prices are right in this case. are not. The user accepts that Artina will be the authority for consideration and decision in order to observe justice in transactions. Since canceled trades will have their effect on the chart and canceling trades will not correct it, that's why a candlestick is displayed on the chart and long shadows are formed, which are only for the reasons explained. Accordingly, the Artina chart is not a reference for displaying the real price of transactions. Rules for canceling orders at unusual prices will be canceled with the increase in market depth and the level of user knowledge.

Be careful in entering the mobile number because this will be one of the ways of our communication with you when there is a problem. To upgrade to level 2 user, the mobile phone number must be in the user's own name. Confirmation of the national card: at this stage, by uploading a high-quality photo of the national card, your national number will be confirmed. Bank card confirmation: In this step, you enter your bank card number. Please note that the name of the bank card holder must match the picture of the national card sent. After this step, you will be able to deposit to your Artina account. Bank account verification: In this step, you enter your account number. Please note that the name of the account holder must match the picture of the national card sent. After this step, you will be able to withdraw from your Artina account. Verification of landline and address: In order to upgrade to level 2 user, it is necessary to provide a landline. At this stage, Artina's authentication experts will contact the landline for confirmation.
